user.title: Monitor your grid-import peaks
user.description: Select cumulative energy imported from the grid, not export, net energy, a single appliance or a daily-reset helper. An optional whole-home power sensor enables forecasts. Estimates start collecting now; no past history is imported. Check that your grid operator uses hourly peaks on distinct days.

data_description.energy_sensor: Lifetime imported energy in Wh, kWh or MWh. Positive, cumulative readings are required.
data_description.power_sensor: Whole-home import in W or kW. A signed net-power sensor is supported; export must be negative.
data_description.target_kw: A personal warning threshold, not a tariff or electrical safety limit. Leave a margin below your tariff boundary.
data_description.peak_days: Use 3 only if your grid operator averages the highest hourly peaks from three different days.
data_description.max_gap_minutes: Intervals longer than this are excluded, not estimated. Default: 5 minutes.

error.invalid_energy: Choose an available cumulative energy sensor (total or total_increasing) with a valid Wh, kWh or MWh reading.
error.invalid_power: Choose an available power sensor with a finite W or kW reading.

abort.already_configured: This energy sensor already has a Nettleievakt entry.

init.title: Threshold and calculation model
init.description: Changes keep existing hourly history. Reloading briefly interrupts collection. This helper estimates hourly peaks only; it does not calculate your electricity bill.
